title: TopologyRelationshipSourceScope
description: Coarse source scope for relationship intents that apply to the current view, current selection, all visible elements, or the active topology scope.

kind.description: How topology-service should choose source candidates before validating them against the relationship.

scopeType.description: Optional topology scope type when kind=scope.

scopeId.description: Optional topology scope id when kind=scope.

limit.description: Optional caller-supplied cap for source candidates. topology-service may apply stricter service-owned limits.
